voice_cards.title: hassmic cards: no cards for voice requests
voice_cards.description: This Home Assistant has no chat log subscription or no conversation id on its assist satellites, which hassmic cards needs to know what a voice request did and which Echo asked. Voice cards are off; hassmic_cards.show still works. An update of hassmic cards may be needed for this Home Assistant version.

yaml.title: hassmic cards: YAML configuration imported
yaml.description: The `hassmic_cards:` settings in configuration.yaml were imported into the integration (Settings → Devices & services → Echo Show cards, its options). Remove them from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

show.name: Show a card
show.description: A dashboard card (entities, glance, tile, weather-forecast, markdown, picture-entity, picture-glance, picture, todo-list, calendar), or one of the card library's by name, on Echo Shows' screens. No target: every Echo Show. Answers with the card's id and the Shows it went to.

card.name: Card
card.description: The card as a dashboard takes it (type and its options), or the name of one of the card library's

id.name: Id
id.description: The same id again updates the card in place; hassmic_cards.clear takes it away by its id

title.name: Title
title.description: In place of the card's own

message.name: Message
message.description: Text beside a picture card's picture

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long it shows; 0 until tapped away or cleared

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: notice (an automation's card) or request (a voice request's: shows while the request is this Echo's, then timeout seconds)

conversation_id.name: Conversation
conversation_id.description: A request's card only for this conversation

actions.name: Buttons
actions.description: Up to 3 buttons, as a phone notification's actions: action (an id), title, and optionally perform_action with data, keep (stays after a press), snooze (minutes: the card goes and comes back). A press fires hassmic_cards_action and the Show's Card button entity

variables.name: Variables
variables.description: For a card's templates: {{ name }} in its strings

clear.name: Clear a card
clear.description: Takes a card off Echo Shows' screens: by its id (wherever it shows; a target narrows it), or with no id whatever the target's Shows show.

id.name: Id
id.description: The card's id (as given to show, or answered by it)

show_message.name: Show a message
show_message.description: A message card from plain fields: a title and words, a camera's picture (moving while it shows) or an image, up to 3 buttons. No target: every Echo Show. Answers with the card's id and the Shows it went to.

title.name: Title
title.description: At the top of the card

message.name: Message
message.description: The words (beside the picture, if there is one)

live.name: Moving picture
live.description: The camera's picture refreshed while the card shows (off: the one picture)

image.name: Image
image.description: A picture's URL (/local/... or http(s)://...), in place of a camera's

id.name: Id
id.description: The same id again updates the card in place; hassmic_cards.clear takes it away by its id

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: How long it shows; 0 until tapped away or cleared

button_1_action.name: Button 1 action
button_1_action.description: The id a press fires hassmic_cards_action with (empty: made from the card's id)

button_2_action.name: Button 2 action
button_2_action.description: The id a press fires hassmic_cards_action with (empty: made from the card's id)

button_3_action.name: Button 3 action
button_3_action.description: The id a press fires hassmic_cards_action with (empty: made from the card's id)

button_1_snooze.name: Button 1 snooze
button_1_snooze.description: Minutes: a press takes the card away and brings it back after them

button_2_snooze.name: Button 2 snooze
button_2_snooze.description: Minutes: a press takes the card away and brings it back after them

user.title: Echo Show cards
user.description: Cards on the screens of Echo Shows running hassmic: for voice requests, and from automations (hassmic_cards.show).

data_description.voice_cards: A card on the Show that was asked: what a request did, the weather, what was asked about. Each Show also has its own Voice cards switch

data_description.library: The dashboard whose views are named cards (a view's URL is its card's name; its first card is the card). Create it in Settings → Dashboards

data_description.weather_tools: A regular expression: an LLM tool whose name matches it answers about the weather (its card: the forecast)
